spanish: Y a todos los reyes del desierto, y a todos los reyes de Egipto que habitan en el desierto.

findings.issue: renders עֲרָ֑ב as 'del desierto' (adds desert concept absent from token)
renders הָעֶ֔רֶב as 'de Egipto' (adds Egypt concept; lemma H6154a is mixed/multitude or Arabia, not Egypt)
applies 'que habitan en el desierto' to both clauses and restructures participants; the desert dwellers modifier applies only to the second group

notes: introduces Egypt and desert where tokens do not license
